label: FACIS DSP — State Bootstrap & Persistence
info:
Postgres-backed persistence for DSP transfers and negotiations.

Startup: dsp-state-restore-fn creates the dsp_transfers / dsp_negotiations
tables if absent, then loads every row into GLOBAL context as
global.set('transfers') / global.set('negotiations'). Both stores are
global-scoped, not flow-scoped: the link-producing flows and the health
endpoint live on other tabs, and Node-RED flow-context is tab-local.

One-time migration: on first boot against an empty table, the legacy
PVC JSON (/data/dsp-state/{transfers,negotiations}.json) is imported once,
then Postgres is the sole source of truth.

Persistence: mutating flows fire the dsp.persist.transfers /
dsp.persist.negotiations links with an empty trigger; the receiver re-reads
the authoritative in-memory map and replaces the table contents in one
transaction (snapshot semantics, same as the old file store).

Retry: if Postgres is still booting when this instance starts, the restore
raises on its catch node, which rate-limits (1/15s, drop) a retry until the
database accepts connections. Persist failures node.error but never crash.

name: restore state from PostgreSQL
persist transfers → PostgreSQL
persist negotiations → PostgreSQL
